answers_open_item.item: Full audit of every other experiment that has ever used modulatory_channel_route_source in {lateral_pfc, curiosity, gated_policy, mech295} without setting e3_score_decomp_enabled

defect.summary: modulatory_channel_route_source values backed by a _bdc_* local are silently inert unless the unrelated diagnostic flag agent.e3.e3_score_decomp_enabled is True; channel_route_bias stays None and the config behaves identically to route_source='none'.

runs.reason: Its confirmed attribution reads the 654j->851 contrast as an effect of WHICH channel is routed. 654j used cand_world_summary (gated-exempt, live); 851 used lateral_pfc (dead). The real contrast is live routing vs NO routing. The MECH-448/449 duty-cycle reduction is real and deterministic but its cause is loss of modulatory channel routing, not the lateral-PFC channel.
